caption: The drawing depicts a wooden tool with a long, cylindrical handle that is vertically attached to a wide, wedge-shaped base. The base features a set of evenly spaced, flat wooden tines extending forward, forming a comb-like structure. Two curved wooden side panels hold the tines in place and are attached to the sides of the base, extending upward to partially enclose the area above the tines. The color palette consists of various shades of brown, with the wood texture and grain visible throughout the handle, tines, and side panels. The tool is placed on a plain, light beige background, and there are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition.
title: Cranberry Picker
